name: Small Magellanic Cloud, field SFH-8 (Hubble)
blurb: SFH-8, a star field in the Small Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: sfh8-hubble
story: A crowd of stars in the Small Magellanic Cloud, a satellite of the Milky Way. Hubble's field pointings here were meant to reconstruct the Small Cloud's star formation history and look for bursts of star formation expected when it interacts with the Large Magellanic Cloud or the Milky Way.

claims.text: SFH-8 is one of the Small Magellanic Cloud field pointings of program 10396
The Small Magellanic Cloud is a satellite of the Milky Way
The field pointings were meant to reconstruct the SMC's star formation history
The program looked for enhanced star formation expected from SMC interactions with the LMC or Milky Way
